# Feature Flag Controller Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Use when configuring and managing feature flags for controlled feature rollout and targeting.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [feature-flag-controller-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
feature-flag-controller-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@feature-flag-controller` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze technical systems and identify areas for improvement
- Execute automated workflows with validation checkpoints
- Apply technology-specific best practices and industry standards
- Generate structured technical outputs with quality metrics

## Industry Standards Applied

- **SOC 2 Type II**: Trust service criteria: security, availability, processing integrity
- **ISO 27001**: Information security management system (ISMS) controls
- **GDPR/CCPA**: Data privacy and protection regulatory requirements
